main.description: One organizer-defined festival day shared across an event's programs. Its date names the day attendees use, even when assigned items continue past midnight.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this schedule record was created.

date.description: The organizer-defined event-local date attendees use to name this festival day. Assigned items may begin after midnight on the following calendar date.

event.description: The DID-based record URI of the events.openmusic.event containing this festival day.

title.description: An optional attendee-facing title that overrides the date's weekday label.
